llm.summary: This is a local Chinese accounting ledger checker with no evidence of hidden network use, persistence, credential access, or destructive behavior.

dimensions.detail: The script reads only the user-specified input file, uses Node standard library modules, enforces a 4 MB input limit, and reports local execution with no network use.

dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No installer, dependency fetch, package installation, remote payload retrieval, or post-install behavior was present in the inspected artifact.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions are narrow and user-directed: run a local Node script with either a sample or a user-provided input file; output and guidance are primarily Chinese.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No file writes, background workers, scheduled tasks, shell subprocesses, credential/session access, memory writes, or privilege escalation behavior were found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose, bundled scripts, sample data, and runtime output all align around checking low-value consumables and amortization ledger tables.

dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable using a Chinese-language, local Node-based checker for copied ledger text. It does not appear to send data out or modify files, but it is a free subset and explicitly omits several checks listed in its documentation.
llm.findings:
[AE1] expected: The referenced scripts/run.mjs file is present and was fully inspected; it is the expected local runner for the skill rather than evidence of analysis evasion.
[SQP-3] expected: Chinese-language instructions, output, and sample data fit the Chinese accounting ledger domain, though non-Chinese users should know the workflow is not localized.
[SDI-4] unexpected: A comment in run.mjs mentions pasted contract text, but the actual runtime help and engine require low-value-consumables ledger text with headers; this appears to be a stale comment, not expanded hidden behavior.
[AIG SARIF] expected: The static scan reported no T01-T09 results, and manual inspection found no instruction hijacking, persistence, remote execution, unsafe dependency, or tool-spoofing behavior.
